name: How much does a high-end kitchen remodel typically cost in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: How much does a high-end kitchen remodel typically cost in Southern California?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a high-end kitchen remodel in Southern California can vary significantly based on size, materials, appliances, and custom features. A full luxury remodel typically starts from $100,000 and can exceed $250,000 for expansive, highly customized projects. Factors influencing cost include custom cabinetry, premium countertops, professional-grade appliances, structural changes, and specialized finishes. We provide a detailed, transparent estimate after the design phase, outlining all expenses.
